summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 1, 2026, announcing only a conference call scheduled for October 5, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. CEST / 8:00 a.m. EDT following commercial close of the I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes project in Tennessee. No stake, price per share, implied value, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is disclosed. The item is an investor-communications notice regarding an infrastructure concession milestone, not a special-situation transaction. No risk-arb angle arises; watch for any future project-financing or investment disclosures.
